facts.text: Serve the tea when Mrs Mills brings in the tray.
facts.why: The transcript has no tea tray; the tea moment is Mrs Mills asking Grace 'Shall I make us a nice cup of tea, ma'am?' once the truth about the house comes out.
facts.fix: Serve the tea when Mrs Mills offers to make a nice cup of tea.

facts.text: Supper by candlelight again, children. Mind the curtains, finish your potatoes, and no talking to anyone you can't see.
facts.why: Grace never says this. Her real lines include 'No one can make us leave this house.' and 'This house is ours.'
facts.fix: No one can make us leave this house.

fix_note.text: No one can make us leave this house.

facts.text: Sleep tight. Mrs Mills checks the curtains twice.
facts.why: Grace is the one strict about the curtains; in the transcript she orders Mrs Mills to close them all, and nothing shows Mrs Mills checking them twice.
facts.fix: Sleep tight. Mrs Mills closes every curtain first.

facts.text: The ring of keys at Grace's belt
facts.why: The transcript has Grace explaining fifteen keys for fifty doors, leaving a set with Mrs Mills and demanding it back, but no source shows the keys at her belt.
facts.fix: Grace and her keys to all fifty doors

vibe.verdict: Dark, quiet manor look with sound 1945 British food, but a room service layout fits a hotel better than a haunted house and the best scares are left out.
